title: Kalkar SNR-300 Fast Breeder Reactor
summary: A sodium-cooled fast breeder prototype in North Rhine-Westphalia was completed in 1985 after 15 years and DM 7 billion but was never fuelled or operated. Successive state and federal governments refused an operating licence amid safety concerns and anti-nuclear politics; the plant was formally abandoned in 1991 and sold to a Dutch investor who converted it into a holiday park.
